display_long_description:
Master the Art of Color Sorting in Virtual Reality!

Step into a relaxing yet mentally stimulating puzzle environment and test your logic with Pour & Sort. If you love brain teasers, this immersive VR adaptation of the classic color-sorting puzzle brings a whole new layer of satisfying gameplay right to your hands. Your mission is simple but challenging: sort the colored liquids in the bottles until each bottle holds only one single color!

Look around your mysterious room, grab a bottle with your VR controllers, and start pouring. But plan your moves carefully—you can only pour liquid into another bottle if it matches the top color and there is enough space left. It starts easy, but as more bottles and complex color combinations are added, you’ll need strategy and sharp logic to solve the chaos.

Key Features:

Immersive VR Puzzling: Experience a highly focused and relaxing atmosphere as you interact with floating puzzle elements in full 3D space.

Intuitive Controls: Seamlessly select and tilt bottles using your VR controllers for a natural, tactile pouring feeling.

Brain-Boosting Logic: Challenge your cognitive skills, spatial awareness, and forward-thinking with hundreds of color combinations.

Satisfying Visuals & Effects: Enjoy bright, highly saturated colors and delightful win celebrations whenever you successfully clear a level.

Multiple Difficulty Levels: Progress at your own pace! Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, or Expert modes to match your puzzle-solving skill.
